mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guard_senior (guard_id, senior_id, status, connected_at) VALUES (#{guardId}, #{wardId}, 'ACTIVE', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'ACTIVE', connected_at = NOW(), revoked_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS ward_id, u.name, u.avatar_id FROM guard_senior gs JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gs.senior_id WHERE gs.guard_id = #{guardId} AND gs.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY gs.connected_at ASC
